pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Morphy Defense, Neo-Arkhangelsk Variation
pages.notes: Neo-Arkhangelsk 5...Bc5: plan 2 routed Nbd2-f1 with the d2-pawn and f1-rook in place; plan 4 suggested an untypical ...d5. Overview and plans now give the 6.Nxe5 Nxe5 7.d4 fork trick and ...b5/...d6/...Bb6. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Rabinovich Variation
pages.notes: Rabinovich: overview said Black gives up only castling (Black is two pawns down too); plan 1 had d4 with a Black knight on it; plan 2 claimed an open f-file. Rewritten around the d4-knight and c5-bishop. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: 5.O-O b5
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted the f3-knight; plan 2 called c5 a light-squared bishop square; plan 4 invented a queenside majority (the pawns are symmetrical). Fixed.

pages.name: Spanish: 5.O-O b5 6.Bb3 Bc5 7.c3
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed Nbd2-f1-g3 with the rook on f1; overview called the line the Archangel Defence. Reviewer rejected a naming claim; overview now describes the line without a name, re-accepted. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: 5.O-O b5 6.Bb3 Bc5 7.c3 d6 8.d4
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted the f3-knight; plan 2 suggested ...d5 with the d-pawn already on d6. Rewritten around 8...Bb6, ...Bg4 and White's a4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: 5.O-O b5 6.Bb3 Bc5 7.Nxe5
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Nxd4 (no knight can reach d4) and claimed Black keeps the bishop pair after ...Bxd4. Rewritten around 8...Bxd4 9.Qxd4 d6. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: 5.O-O b5 6.Bb3 Be7
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Nf1-g3 with no knight on f1; plan 2 had a ...c5 break blocked by the c6-knight. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: 5.O-O b5 6.Bb3 Be7
pages.notes: Overview and plan 2 said 7...exd4 leads to the Open Spanish (that is 5...Nxe4); plan 3 rerouted the f3-knight. Rewritten around 7...d6 8.c3 Bg4 and 7...exd4 8.e5 Ne4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Archangelsk, 7.c3 Nxe4
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed Nbd2-f1-g3 with the d2-pawn and f1-rook in place; now Nbd2 after d4 against the e4-knight. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Archangelsk, 7.d3
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the knight through f1 before Re1; plan 2 had a ...c5 break blocked by the c6-knight and an invented queenside majority; plan 3 put a c2-bishop on the d1-h5 diagonal. Fixed. British spelling.
